description: Reviewed onboarding policy for third-party MCP servers (pipeline parasol-tool-onboarding). pins: the sha256 of the tool definitions (name, description, input schema) a person reviewed, per version; a version with no pin, or a different sha256, is not promoted. contract: calls run against the image inside the pipeline; each result must contain expect and pass the MCP gateway's NeMo check. parasol_tools: tool names of Parasol's own servers; a third-party description that names one is refused.
